comment: The missed mechanism was optimizer-specific short-budget behavior, not nominal Δ alone. For this identical 2-LN residual SiLU network, Adagrad at 1e-3 is the only adequately aggressive setting (C); Adam 1e-4 follows (D). Momentum SGD at 1e-4 still beats the two very-low-progress adaptive runs, while RMSprop 3e-5 beats Adagrad 3e-4; the latter is especially weakened by Adagrad’s accumulator and 1e-3 weight decay. K1002 helped identify C versus D, but K1001/K1003 misled when treating Δ/calibration as a reliable total order. Similar spiral records q_6efbc4 and q_e1901f show that low-rate optimizer ordering is empirical and architecture/budget scoped.
